pages.text: The $(thing)Sewing Table$() is used to produce banner patterns, smithing templates, and other cloth items. It requires $(t:#tfc:sewing_light_cloth)$(6)Light Cloth$(), $(t:#tfc:sewing_dark_cloth)$(6)Dark Cloth$(), $(t:#forge:string)$(6)String$(), as well as a $(item)Needle$().$(br)A needle for sewing can be made from a bone. An indestructable needle can be made later on out of stainless steel.
裁縫テーブルのインベントリは、作業台のインベントリに似ています。間違えた場合は、インベントリを終了するだけで、アイテムは返されます。GUIにはレシピブックがあり、本を選択するとメニューが開き、レシピを選択できます。これにより、作業面に実行するステップの小さな指示が表示されます。

The slots on the left are for the string and the needle. The two bottom slots can hold any combination of dark and light cloth. The slot on the right will show the result when it is ready to be taken. Taking the result from the result slot completes the craft, and uses the items.

Each cloth item allows placing 8 squares of that material on the sewing surface. Similarly, each string item allows placing 16 stitches. When you have selected a recipe, just use the buttons on the top right of the screen to place squares and stitch them together as shown by the guide. Want to remove stitches? Use the red 'X' button to get rid of squares.

pages.title: 旗の加工台
pages.text: 旗のパターンを作成するための旗の加工台は、旗のパターンを使用して作業するために作られます。

pages.title: Armor Trims
pages.text: Armor trims can be applied to any $(t:#minecraft:trimmable_armor)$(6)Trimmable Armor$() by sewing a $(item)Smithing Template$(). Combine it with a $(t:#minecraft:trim_materials)$(6)Trim Material$() (like $(thing)Exquisite Gems$() or $(thing)Jewlery Metal$()) and the armor on a $(item)Smithing Table$().
